implementation.recovery: Synchronous admission; 15-second signals; no automatic replay; GET observes current state, then explicit fresh-revision retry; unknown/closed review retained only within owner.
implementation.acknowledgement: Publish existing remote/list/project/recent canonical location before detached handled refresh. Preserve higher revisions/detail fields/reading anchors/global pins. Remove confirmed old-source rows, never add missing rows or guess counts/relation timestamps.
implementation.focus: After phase changes, only body/lost focus targets the existing first enabled Close button with preventScroll; another selected control and closed dialog are left alone. Explicit DOM/effect doubles only.

implementation.compatibility: Optional getProjects/placeConversation signals only; legacy argument calls and HTTP payloads retained. Existing server default/archive mapping, atomic placement and pin/no-op rules unchanged. No migration/dependency/offline/Share/bulk/DnD changes.
